parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the ESM, .mjs, no-dependency, manual argparse, and exact output requirements, and sampled baseline, equal-value, quote, negative-number, and error behavior before delegation.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It split ownership into four child scopes: formatting, DeepDiff/Delta, argparse, and the entry file, while the parent retained final integration and verification responsibility.
parallel.implementation: Children wrote five files. The integrated DeepDiff/Delta path handled flat object additions, removals, and changed values but not multiline string diff metadata or long Delta string truncation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent consumed the completed swarm result, ran node versus executable comparisons, read each output file, and delivered /output/test15.mjs plus lib/argparse.mjs, lib/deepdiff.mjs, lib/delta.mjs, and lib/pyformat.mjs.
parallel.verification: Parallel verification covered the sample, equal y, quote/backslash, negative and zero integers, tabs, argparse errors, --arg=value, and missing values, and those local checks matched.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 3 of 70 samples. The visible implementation lacks the serial run's multiline string diff field and Delta long-string truncation logic.

serial.requirements: The serial actor recognized the same ESM, no-dependency, argument parsing, output formatting, and black-box executable observation requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It owned the whole migration locally, tracking stages for formatter, JSON serialization, splitlines, difflib, DeepDiff/Delta, argparse, entry file, and verification.
serial.implementation: It implemented a broader helper stack including pyjson.mjs, pystr.mjs, difflib.mjs, and DeepDiff/Delta logic for multiline unified diffs and Delta string truncation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial actor assembled all modules in one output tree and checked imports and file structure, but the main turn was cancelled after a long fuzzer remained in progress.
serial.verification: It ran many direct comparisons against the executable, fixed failures around multiline splitting and Delta truncation, checked argparse exit codes, and started a randomized fuzzer that did not return before cancellation.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 2 of 70 samples and the agent timed out without a normal final response, although artifact validation copied the generated files.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail from the current completed cell/status.json evaluations, with parallel at 67/70 and serial at 68/70. The process difference is still concrete: parallel delegated DeepDiff/Delta under a narrow sample-derived contract and delivered a simple changed-value implementation, while serial discovered and implemented multiline diff metadata and Delta long-string truncation before timing out. The mounted pair does not expose individual failing official samples, so this is a supported explanation for the quality gap rather than proof of an exclusive root cause.
parallel_contributors: The DeepDiff/Delta child contract omitted multiline diff metadata and Delta truncation behavior while the parent later accepted a limited harness.
The final parallel implementation visible in the readback only reports new_value and old_value for changed strings and does not include the serial truncation helper.
serial_contributors: The serial actor explicitly probed multiline string behavior and discovered the diff field and Delta first-character truncation.
The serial implementation incorporated splitlines, unified diff generation, and Delta string truncation, raising official coverage by one sample despite timeout.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial used a larger helper architecture and a long fuzzer; this consumed budget and caused agent timeout but also improved edge-case coverage.
Both artifacts still failed official evaluation, so remaining defects are ordinary implementation gaps not fully identifiable from the mounted summaries.
evaluator_effects: Only aggregate official counts are mounted; individual failing samples are not available inside the isolated pair.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No pass/fail outcome difference; the retained pattern is a supported contributor to the parallel quality gap, not an exclusive root cause.
